articles.title: Keralam Minister Bindu Krishna slams Kanthapuram’s directive on ‘restricting’ women at public events
articles.sum: Bindu Krishna says such directives can push women “centuries back” and should not be accepted in a society that guarantees equal rights to men and women

articles.title: Expect everybody to act in responsible manner: SC refuses to prohibit CJP’s September 5 protest march
articles.sum: The CJP has called for a protest march in Delhi, accusing the Centre of failing to honour the promises made on July 25 to persuade the group to withdraw its 36-day agitation against examination irregularities

articles.title: Madras High Court reserves orders on M.K. Stalin’s plea to declare him elected from Kolathur constituency
articles.sum: Chief Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari and Justice G. Arul Murugan permit the former Chief Minister to withdraw another writ petition challenging certain provisions of the SOP framed by the ECI for verifying 5% of EVM sets

articles.title: Mettur Dam: the water source for Tamil Nadu’s rice belt
articles.sum: With poor monsoon, the release has been delayed this year and Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will open water from dam on September 1, 2026

articles.title: SC says probe agencies tend to go slow on the powerful, but quick to act with commoners
articles.sum: The observations were made while hearing a petition filed by Sumit Roy, the personal assistant to Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee, in connection with the Salboni land-grabbing case

articles.title: No roofs, no toilets, no teachers: TOI check finds minuses in Rajasthan govt schools
